value: After the avatar is defeated, its essence is placed within the Ancient Egg. Yeh'kinya says he will keep the vessel safe, yet the quest's closing unease leaves the matter unsettled: the egg stirs. A containment ritual has reached its stated end, but the story does not grant the seeker proof that the danger has passed.
editorNote: Original paraphrase. Scene order follows quest-chain order and does not assert exact date or unsupported causal links. Secondary locators and original-client limits are recorded in the research packet.
